title: The night of the Whitsuntide play had come and Stephen from the window of the dressing-room looked out on the small grass-plot across which lines of Chinese lanterns were stretched.
html_source:
Whitsuntide, also known as Pentecost elsewhere, is the seventh sunday after Easter.

A play is being held that evening at Belvedere.

anchor.text: The night of the Whitsuntide play had come and Stephen from the window of the dressing-room looked out on the small grass-plot across which lines of Chinese lanterns were stretched.
anchor.prefix:
He reassumed the provincial’s voice and repeated:

 —I told them all at dinner about it and Father Dolan and I and all of us we had a hearty laugh together over it. Ha! Ha! Ha!
